subcategory_text: Interoperability frameworks or similar multi-party approaches are used to manage data processing ecosystem privacy risks.
informative_references: GDPR Art. 26 (Joint controllers), Art. 22 (Joint controllership arrangements)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.SC-09 (supply chain risks identified and prioritised)
implementation_examples: Adopt or join an interoperability framework (e.g., sectoral codes of conduct, multi-party risk registers) where direct bilateral contracts are insufficient
Document the interoperability framework, scope, parties, and obligations
Contribute to multi-party exercises to validate shared privacy-risk assumptions
assessment_objectives: Determine whether interoperability frameworks are adopted when bilateral controls are insufficient
Determine whether framework scope, parties, and obligations are documented
Determine whether multi-party exercises test the framework periodically
Determine whether the framework covers incident coordination, dispute resolution, and shared learning
